Items that the HIQA draft, or other authoritative sources available to this PoC, do not settle. Nothing here is
invented. Where the IG needs a value in the meantime, it uses a clearly named placeholder and points back to this list.

Issues inherited from IE Core keep IE Core's number (OI-0xx), so references in the copied profiles still resolve.
Issues specific to this IG are numbered OI-1xx.
